title: Construction / EPC: bill a project by milestones, with retention

steps.do: [BDM] Quotation → Overview → "Billing by milestones" → "Set up milestones" → "Fill a common example". Retention % 10; tick "Releases retention" on "After the warranty period". Press "Save the schedule".
steps.expect: "Adds up to 100% ✓" before saving; then "Billing schedule saved — 4 milestone(s)." The table shows 10% ₹1,00,000 · 40% ₹4,00,000 · 40% ₹4,00,000 · 10% ₹1,00,000 and the retention sentence.
steps.observed: "Adds up to 100% ✓" → "Billing schedule saved — 4 milestone(s)."; table 10% ₹1,00,000 · 40% ₹4,00,000 · 40% ₹4,00,000 · 10% ₹1,00,000 and the retention sentence.

steps.do: Change one share so they add up to 90% and save.
steps.expect: Refused: "The milestones add up to 90% — they must add up to 100% of the price. Nothing was saved."
steps.observed: Refused: "The milestones add up to 90% — they must add up to 100% of the price. Nothing was saved." (the form itself warned "Adds up to 90% — it must add up to 100%.").

steps.expect: A "Payment milestones" section lists each milestone with its share and amount "plus GST", and the retention sentence.
steps.observed: PDF "Payment milestones": 1. Advance — with the order — 10% — 1,00,000.00 plus GST | 2. Design / drawings approved — 40% — 4,00,000.00 plus GST | 3. Delivery / completion — 40% — 4,00,000.00 plus GST | 4. After the warranty period — 10% — 1,00,000.00 plus GST (retention released on thi

steps.do: Submit for approval, then change the schedule.
steps.expect: Saved with "…the approval was cancelled — submit it again."
steps.observed: "Billing schedule saved — 4 milestone(s). The billing schedule is part of what is approved, so the approval was cancelled — submit it again." — back to Draft.

steps.do: Approve, send, mark accepted; Finance registers the contract; manager endorses, branch manager approves (contract Open). Open the contract.
steps.expect: "Billing by milestones" shows the same four milestones, all "Planned", with "✓ Mark reached".
steps.observed: Contract AHM/C/2026-27/00001 OPEN; its "Billing by milestones" shows the four milestones (10/35/45/10 after step 4), all Planned, each with "✓ Mark reached".

steps.expect: No "Mark reached" button — Finance bills milestones, it does not confirm them.
steps.observed: Finance sees the milestones with no "Mark reached".

steps.do: [Coordinator] "✓ Mark reached" on the advance: date tomorrow.
steps.expect: Refused: a milestone cannot be reached in the future.
steps.observed: The calendar stops at today (max 2026-11-15); a date tomorrow sent anyway is refused: "A milestone cannot be reached in the future — give the date it actually happened. | In force. Within its term and quantity. quantity 0 of 1 used"

steps.do: Date today, "What shows it is reached?" = "PO received 12 Nov", attach the PO PDF → "Confirm — ready to bill".
steps.expect: "Marked reached. Finance sees it under Billing → Due to bill." The row shows "Reached — ready to bill", who, when, the note and a 📎 link that opens the file.
steps.observed: "Marked reached. Finance sees it under Billing → Due to bill. | In force. Within its term and quantity. quantity 0 of 1 used" Row: "1 Advance — with the order Reached 15 Nov 2026 · Test Coord — PO received 12 Nov · 📎 po.pdf 10% ₹1,00,000 Reached — ready to bill Undo"; the 📎 link opens the PDF.

steps.do: [Finance] Money → Billable events → Due to bill.
steps.expect: The milestone is listed for the client, "Milestone reached: Advance — with the order". Tick it → "Raise one invoice for the ticked units".
steps.observed: Money → Billable events → Due to bill: TB Group Parent, "Milestone reached: Advance — with the order"; ticked → "Raise one invoice for the ticked units" → "1 unit(s) put on a draft invoice — review it and issue."

steps.expect: Line "Milestone — <contract> — Advance — with the order (10%)" ₹1,00,000 + GST = ₹1,18,000; then "Less: retention 10% — payable when “After the warranty period” is reached − ₹10,000" and "Payable now ₹1,08,000".
steps.observed: "Milestone — AHM/C/2026-27/00001 — Advance — with the order (10%)" ₹1,00,000 + GST = ₹1,18,000; "Less: retention 10% … − ₹10,000"; "Payable now ₹1,08,000".

steps.expect: The invoice is aged for ₹1,08,000 only — the ₹10,000 retention is not due and not chased.
steps.observed: "Invoice issued. It is now in the customer's ledger and in th"; Receivables: "TB Group Parent 1 ₹1,08,000 — — — — ₹1,08,000 —" — aged for ₹1,08,000 only.

steps.expect: No Undo offered (it is billed). On a reached milestone not yet invoiced, Undo with a reason sets it back to Planned and off the Due to bill list.
steps.observed: No Undo on the billed advance; "Design / drawings approved" reached (listed due: true), then Undo with a reason → "Set back to planned — it is no longer due to bill." — back to Planned and off Due to bill.

steps.do: [Finance] On the open contract, "Change the schedule" → change shares → "Request the amendment" with a reason.
steps.expect: An amendment waits for two signatures; the current schedule stays until approved; reached milestones never change.
steps.observed: "Request the amendment" (3 planned rows editable) → "Amendment requested. It needs two signatures — first Operation Manager, Business Unit Head, Admin (legacy), Bu"; the current schedule stays until both signatures; the reached advance is unchanged (true).

steps.do: [Coordinator] Mark "After the warranty period" reached; open Receivables.
steps.expect: The retention on the earlier invoices is now due and counted.
steps.observed: "Marked reached. Finance sees it under Billing → Due to bill."; Receivables now counts the retention: "TB Group Parent 1 ₹1,18,000 — — — — ₹1,18,000 —"; contract: "Held so far: ₹10,000 · still to collect: ₹10,000 · payable since 15 Nov 2026 Change the schedule"
